conflicts.description: Genomics Division wants to secure Mother Tithe for shareholders, Continuity Office wants to evacuate, and Extraction Division wants to keep production running, forcing a three-way struggle over the colony's future.
conflicts.name: Save the Station or Sell the Creature

conflicts.description: The expanding Chorus threatens to absorb the workforce, while department heads try to contain, exploit, or negotiate with it.
conflicts.name: Chorus Against Corporate Control

description: Mariana Six is a corporate deep-sea colony anchored in the abyssal dark of the Atlantic, where three competing corporate departments breed bio-engineered leviathans to harvest rare enzymes worth more than the station itself. This is biopunk at its most claustrophobic and tense: living architecture, engineered tissue, pressure-scarred workers, and quarterly targets enforced by people who answer to shareholders far above the waves. The largest leviathan, Mother Tithe, has developed a contagious sentience that spreads through enzyme exposure, converting workers into a hive mind. Three rival department heads must decide whether to save the station or secure the creature for their shareholders, and every alliance is shaped by profit, fear, and the dwindling air supply.

factions.description: Led by a quota-driven head who wants to keep the leviathans producing and the colony running, even at the cost of containing the infected workers by force.
factions.name: Extraction Division

factions.description: Led by an ambitious scientist-executive who sees the sentient leviathan as a patentable breakthrough and wants it secured, studied, and sold exclusively.
factions.name: Genomics Division

factions.description: Led by a risk-averse administrator who answers to insurers and wants the station evacuated or sealed, protecting liability and human life before assets.
factions.name: Continuity Office

factions.description: The growing hive mind of infected workers, speaking in shared murmurs and gathering around Mother Tithe. Its goals are unclear but increasingly unified.
factions.name: The Chorus

history.description: Three corporate departments jointly established the colony to farm enzymes from engineered deep-sea organisms.
history.name: Founding of Mariana Six

history.description: The first stable leviathan hatched in the Brood Cathedral, proving the harvest model and triggering a profit boom.
history.name: Birth of the First Leviathan

history.description: Workers protested punishing enzyme quotas, and Extraction Division quelled the unrest with sealed corridors and rationed air.
history.name: The Quota Riots

history.description: Mother Tithe grew far beyond projected size and began producing rare enzymes at triple yield, making her the colony's most valuable asset.
history.name: Mother Tithe Surpasses Design

history.description: A harvest crew returned from the trench speaking in unison, marking the first sign of the contagious sentience.
history.name: The First Awakening

locations.description: A vast engineered canyon beneath the colony where leviathans are penned in living-membrane enclosures and milked of enzymes by tethered crews.
locations.name: Harvest Trench

locations.description: A vaulted hatchery of translucent tanks and ribbed tissue walls where leviathan embryos are gestated. It houses Mother Tithe, the largest leviathan, whose sentience first emerged here.
locations.name: Brood Cathedral

locations.description: The circular habitation deck where workers sleep, eat, and trade rumors. Its dim corridors are slick with condensation and bioluminescent mold.
locations.name: The Pressure Ring

locations.description: A glass-walled executive level where department heads meet, negotiate, and sabotage one another under the watch of remote shareholder feeds.
locations.name: Board Gallery

locations.description: Chilled laboratories and armored storage where raw enzymes are refined, measured, and locked away. Whoever controls the vaults controls the colony's value.
locations.name: Assay Vaults

name: Mariana Six

rules.statement: Unprotected exposure to the abyssal depth is fatal within seconds, so every excursion requires pressure suits or sealed transit tubes.
The sentience spreads through contact with Mother Tithe's enzyme secretions, which bind to human nervous tissue and link infected minds.
The colony's biological scrubbers can sustain only a limited population, and sealing sections of the station quickly degrades the remaining air.
All major decisions must be reported to shareholders on a delayed uplink, so executives act with partial authority and heavy legal exposure.
All power, tools, and weapons on the station are mechanical, chemical, or bioengineered, and all of the leviathans are products of lab-grown genetics.
